_comment: Source of truth for the feedback survey. scripts/create_survey.py builds the survey from this file via the Qualtrics API, writes qualtrics-map.json, and generates feedback/questions.md (do not edit that file). Each page is one Qualtrics block (= one survey page). Questions are numbered Q1..Qn automatically, in page order. 'field' names the question: it is the key in response files, the target of 'show_if', and '{field}' in intro, notes, or question text is replaced by the question's number. 'export': false keeps an answer out of the map (email). 'show_if' must refer to a question on an earlier page.
name: readme-bot: README review feedback
intro: Thanks for testing the README review skill. Your answers (without your email) are shared with the skill's maintainers in a private repository, where a maintainer decides whether to use them. Please do not include confidential data, unpublished results, or names. Please answer yourself; do not let an AI assistant fill in the survey. An assistant may help you draft the text for {proposal}.
notes: Each page is one Qualtrics block; "Shown if" always refers to an earlier page. Follow-up text questions ({false_findings_text}, {missed_issues_text}, {invented_facts_text}, {tool_other}) are separate questions, not text boxes on a choice, so they export under a predictable key (`QIDn_TEXT`).

{tool}–{model} separate the vendor ({tool}, {tool_other}), the kind of interface ({interface}: chat vs. coding agent), how the instructions were loaded ({instructions}: skill vs. prompt file), and the model ({model}). The skill is not Claude-only: the prompt file works in any chatbot.
{invented_facts} "Yes" is flagged as priority in the PR.

{proposal} is untrusted input. The pull script vets it (and all other free text) before it reaches a maintainer; see "Security vetting" in [FEEDBACK_PLAN.md](FEEDBACK_PLAN.md). It is never applied to the skill directly: a maintainer rewrites any change they accept.
{consent} is recorded as `public_quote_ok`. "No" still yields a (private) PR; the response is then used only in aggregate or in the maintainer's own words.
{email} has `export: false`, so it is not in `qualtrics-map.json` and never leaves Qualtrics.
